tool_args.rationale: The short-horizon observations are monotone and concave, but all have nearly identical sink gradient, so the gradient-dependent candidate mechanisms remain confounded. The lower-cost open-branch discriminating probe is the targeted next measurement.

considered_alternatives.option: Author a model from the five initial rows
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The s_grad range is only 0.018, leaving sink inhibition and branch terms weakly identifiable; several archived mechanisms share a similar monotone-concave response in this narrow pilot.
The supplied rows vary input at one fixed horizon and do not particularly indicate coupled-memory ODE ambiguity; this batch is higher cost and not the targeted discrimination.
Auxiliary nuisance measurements are explicitly irrelevant to identifying the response law.
